messages.body_plain:
On Sunday, 15 March 2020 21.05.46 WET Orlando Ramirez wrote:
> Hi i installed 4 times " Rstudio " on my fedora desktop in the last 2
> weeks...i don't know why  " Rstudio " disapear of my programs....... ....i
> install it again , it works between 3 or 6 times and then disapear of my
> programs again...why ???? can you please help me...and thanks again

What do you mean by disappear?
Does it disappears from the menu, from the installed programs?

How did you install it?

By the way do you know that you can install it from Fedora (starting from 
Fedora 31)?

sudo dnf install rstudio-desktop

-- 
José Abílio
